en-US.author: Synthetify Labs sp. z o.o.
en-US.description: A free desktop app that runs AI agents as a team on your own computer
en-US.longDescription: OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration, using the subscription plan you already pay for or your own model.
en-US.name: OpenBot
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fixed
- An agent that sends a message to a working teammate now knows if the message went into the teammate's running task, or why it waits. Before, the agent got "queued" every time, also when the message went into the running task, so it could not tell you what happened. When the teammate's "While working" setting is Queue, the agent can tell you to set it to Steer.
- When you ask an agent to show its cursor during Computer Use, it no longer tells you that the cursor overlay is unavailable. OpenBot draws the agent cursor where the agent clicks, scrolls or moves in another app. Agents no longer get the driver's own cursor tools, which OpenBot turns off.
- Agents can now use an n8n MCP server that you signed in to through OpenBot. Before, the server test showed the server as ready, but each agent chat could not connect to it, because n8n blocked the name that OpenBot sent with each request. You no longer need to add a User-Agent header to the server to make it work.
- Gemini installs and updates on Windows again. Before, OpenBot 0.67.0 stopped with "The runtime archive contains a link or special file.", because the Windows download of the Antigravity CLI does not mark its program as a file.

zh-CN.description: 在你自己的电脑上以团队方式运行 AI Agent 的免费桌面应用
zh-CN.longDescription: OpenBot 是一款本地优先的桌面工作区，用于管理持久的 AI 队友。它可以在专用工作区中运行 Codex、Claude 和 Grok，提供任务队列、文件共享、浏览器控制以及 Agent 之间的协作，直接使用你已经付费的订阅套餐或你自己的模型。
